top.line: DeepSeek as an owner's choice: open weights, low prices, browser calls, data in China, and a Wikipedia explorer.

in-short.line: A choice; MIT weights and two API formats; low prices; data in China; Wikipedia first.

why.line: The model is the owner's choice; DeepSeek was already one of the Swarm's four open-weight models.

offer.line: Flash and V4-Pro, MIT weights, OpenAI and Anthropic formats, 0.30 and 1.20 dollars, browser calls checked.

data.line: Its service stores data in China and lists training; public data there, private data on hosts or devices.

workflows.line: Behind one interface: in the Swarm and evals, bulk work on public data, under the same rules.

explorer.line: Load Wikipedia in code, read with DeepSeek, check quotes and anchor to Wikidata, draw, keep the run.

limits.line: Not built; preflight only; terms as read; other hosts have their own terms.

sources.line: DeepSeek's, hosts' and Wikimedia's pages, and our own preflight checks, on 21 November 2026.
